_about: Friend/family check of uncertain defects (confidence 0.3-0.5). One record per photo. save_feedback() in clothes_inspect_model.py turns a fully answered record into a YOLO training image + label: yes -> labelled defect, no -> nothing (if every spot is 'no', the photo becomes a clean negative). Photos with unanswered spots are not used.

request.askImage: <jpeg base64: numbered close-ups of the uncertain spots, faces blurred>
request.question: 사진의 번호마다 얼룩이나 찢어진 곳이 맞는지 알려 주세요.

noAnswer._about: Photos are never sent to GPT. With no friend set up, or no answer yet, spots keep status 'ask' and source stays 'model'; the agent says they are uncertain (e.g. '확실하지 않지만 오른쪽 가슴에 얼룩이 있을 수 있어요').

storage._about: Keep the original full photo server-side only until the check is answered, then pass it with the request's spots and the answers to save_feedback(); the friend only ever sees askImage.
storage.image: original JPEG (not the close-up), used for the training label
storage.label: YOLO txt: '<class> <cx> <cy> <w> <h>' per confirmed defect, class 0 = stain, 1 = tear
